findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：CVS 提供訂閱制會員方案 ExtraCare Plus；2025 年關閉 221 家零售門市；10-K 並指出產業朝消費者導向的零售市場（私有／公共交易所）演進，增加新進者與非傳統通路（如零售業者）的競爭風險。
findings.excerpt: The Company also offers a subscription-based membership program, ExtraCare PlusTM, under which members are entitled to a suite of benefits delivered over the course of the subscription period

findings.claim: 10-K：2025 年全年關閉 221 家零售門市（企業重組計畫）。
findings.excerpt: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company closed 221 retail stores in connection with this action.

findings.claim: Aetna 宣布 2026 年退出 ACA 個人交易所市場，約 100 萬會員需換保。
findings.excerpt: “We are disappointed by the continued underperformance from our individual exchange products and have recently determined there is not a near- or long-term pathway for Aetna to materially improve its position,” CVS CEO David Joyner told investors on a Thursday morning call.

findings.claim: CVS 預期 2026 年新開店數多於關店，聚焦較小型健康導向門市。

note: 搜尋摘要另顯示 Aetna 2025-05 宣布退出 2026 年 ACA 個人交易所（約 100 萬會員、17 州），及 2026 年起新開店數超過關店；未讀到可逐字複製的頁面，列入 clues。未查到 D2C／平台化結構轉變的一手來源。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
